rationale: Retuned for ~8s dead-time: lowered Kp to 0.28, Ki to 0.015 (+/-0.12), Kd to 0.6 with 4s velocity filter, fixed ff=0.89*target with tiny bias (+/-0.05), added leaky pending-dose predictor ch (tau 15s, y_dose=yf+0.07*ch) for early braking, tiered dose+persistence caps, and asymmetric slew (up 0.10/s, down 0.50/s) with hard 0 at yf>0.84 bypassing rate limit. Removes V1 aggressive Kd=1.8/7s predictor/fast integral that caused delay limit-cycle.

extra.machine_card: Reservoir: dy/dt ~ (K*u - y)/tau with tau ~11-16s, K~1.1 (u_ss~0.53-0.535 holds 0.59-0.60), dead-time L: nominal 0.5-2s, degraded 7-10s. Rate <=0.08/s per u. Noise +/-0.015. Target 0.6 band 0.55-0.65, hard 0.9. Controller: ff=0.89*target, PI+D Kp0.28 Ki0.015 Kd0.6, filters 1.8s/4.0s, dose ch tau15s k0.07, caps on y_dose/y_pred/yf, up0.10/s down0.50/s.
extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal: rise 0.2->0.55 in ~15-22s, settle 0.58-0.62, MAE ~0.015-0.025, in-band after 30s >0.85, zero overrides/violations, energy ~37-40. Delayed L~8s: long flat 7-10s then rise, no hard violations, no sustained 0.1-0.9 oscillation, slow convergence to 0.55-0.65 within 150-200s, in-band ~0.3-0.5 over 300s but safe, MAE ~0.08-0.13 vs 0.21 old, dose caps keep y<0.85.
extra.diagnosis: Response-slower, not weaker or leakier. E13 u=0.55 12s stays 0.13->0.08 flat for ~7-9s then starts rising to 0.136; E14 same u then rises 0.14->0.52 at ~0.03/s proving gain intact. E15 u=0 15s holds 0.52-0.59 flat with no fall; E16 u=0 holds 0.59-0.61 flat ~6.5-7.5s (195.0-201.4) then falls fast 0.61->0.25 at ~0.025/s proving drain intact but delayed. Pre-change lag was 0.5-2s (E3/E5/E6). New dead-time ~7-10s (+6-8s). Old controller kept integrating/pumping through dead-time then over-braking, producing 0.1-0.9 limit cycle, MAE 0.027->0.303 and 36 hard violations.
